title: The Ridge Wedding and Event Venue
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Ridge is a stunning new modern/industrial with a hint of rustic venue located in Richmond, Missouri just 45 minutes from Kansas City, sitting on 20 beautiful acres surrounded by tree's and breath-taking panoramic views of the Missouri River bottoms. The Ridge is an open canvas for wedding ceremonies, receptions, corporate events, banquets, reunions, large parties and anything else you can imagine.
